documents.title: Owner-confirmed technology inventory

Education Platform Modernization: Legacy systems: Application: PHPMaker, PHP 5; Database: MySQL 5.7; Web server: Apache; Hosting: On-premises, AWS EC2. Modern systems: Application: Laravel, Node.js, React; Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL; Web servers: Nginx, Apache; Hosting & orchestration: On-premises, AWS ECS, AWS EC2, Kubernetes, Third-party cloud provider.
